```{=html}
<svg class="hv-roles" viewBox="0 0 1600 940" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
     role="img" aria-labelledby="hv-roles-title hv-roles-desc">
  <title id="hv-roles-title">Which hubverse tools serve which role</title>
  <desc id="hv-roles-desc">A hub sits at the centre. Around it are four roles: hub administrators who
    configure it, modelers who submit model output, analysts who build ensembles, visualisations and
    evaluations, and stakeholders who consume the results. A panel on the right fills in the hubverse
    tools each role uses.</desc>

  <defs>
    <symbol id="hv-person" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
      <circle cx="12" cy="7" r="4.3"/>
      <path d="M2.6 22.5c0-5.2 4.2-9.4 9.4-9.4s9.4 4.2 9.4 9.4z"/>
    </symbol>
    <marker id="hv-arrow-amber" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5"
            markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M0 0 L10 5 L0 10 z" fill="#d1861b"/>
    </marker>
    <marker id="hv-arrow-blue" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5"
            markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M0 0 L10 5 L0 10 z" fill="#3b88bf"/>
    </marker>
    <marker id="hv-arrow-purple" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5"
            markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M0 0 L10 5 L0 10 z" fill="#7d5ba6"/>
    </marker>
    <marker id="hv-arrow-teal" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5"
            markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse">
      <path d="M0 0 L10 5 L0 10 z" fill="#2f9e8f"/>
    </marker>
  </defs>

  <!-- ================= BASE: the hub, and the empty toolbox ================= -->
  <g>
    <rect x="370" y="150" width="540" height="282" rx="18" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#3b88bf" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <path d="M370 168 a18 18 0 0 1 18-18 h504 a18 18 0 0 1 18 18 v37 h-540 z" fill="#3b88bf"/>
    <text x="640" y="190" text-anchor="middle" fill="#ffffff" font-size="23" font-weight="600">The hub</text>

    <!-- the toolbox, empty to begin with -->
    <rect x="1010" y="20" width="570" height="880" rx="18" fill="#f7fafc" stroke="#3b88bf" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-dasharray="7 5"/>
    <text x="1295" y="64" text-anchor="middle" fill="#3b88bf" font-size="27" font-weight="600">the hubverse</text>
    <text x="1295" y="92" text-anchor="middle" fill="#5b5b5b" font-size="14">one toolbox, every hub draws from it</text>
  </g>

  <!-- ========================= 1. HUB ADMINISTRATOR ========================= -->
  <g class="fragment" data-fragment-index="1">
    <!-- hub-config/: a small stack of schema-checked config files -->
    <rect x="390" y="222" width="160" height="190" rx="12" fill="#eaf3fa" stroke="#3b88bf" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <text x="470" y="250" text-anchor="middle" fill="#24628f" font-size="14" font-weight="600" font-family="'Fira Code', monospace">hub-config/</text>
    <g font-family="'Fira Code', monospace" font-size="13" fill="#24628f" text-anchor="middle">
      <rect x="418" y="264" width="104" height="26" rx="5" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#3b88bf" stroke-width="1.3"/>
      <text x="470" y="282">{ }</text>
      <rect x="418" y="296" width="104" height="26" rx="5" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#3b88bf" stroke-width="1.3"/>
      <text x="470" y="314">{ }</text>
      <rect x="418" y="328" width="104" height="26" rx="5" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#3b88bf" stroke-width="1.3"/>
      <text x="470" y="346">{ }</text>
    </g>
    <text x="470" y="382" text-anchor="middle" fill="#5b5b5b" font-size="12.5">what to predict,</text>
    <text x="470" y="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#5b5b5b" font-size="12.5">and in what form</text>

    <!-- target-data/: what actually happened -->
    <rect x="745" y="222" width="145" height="190" rx="12" fill="#e8f6f4" stroke="#2f9e8f" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <text x="817" y="250" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1f7568" font-size="13.5" font-weight="600" font-family="'Fira Code', monospace">target-data/</text>
    <polyline points="759,348 779,338 799,300 819,270 839,296 859,332 879,346"
              fill="none" stroke="#2f9e8f" stroke-width="2.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="817" y="382" text-anchor="middle" fill="#5b5b5b" font-size="12.5">what actually</text>
    <text x="817" y="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#5b5b5b" font-size="12.5">happened</text>

    <rect x="500" y="18" width="280" height="76" rx="14" fill="#eaf3fa" stroke="#3b88bf" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <use href="#hv-person" x="522" y="38" width="36" height="36" fill="#3b88bf"/>
    <text x="574" y="52" fill="#24628f" font-size="20" font-weight="600">Hub administrator</text>
    <text x="574" y="76" fill="#5b5b5b" font-size="13.5">designs and runs the hub</text>
    <path d="M640 96 L640 146" stroke="#3b88bf" stroke-width="2.6" fill="none" marker-end="url(#hv-arrow-blue)"/>
    <path d="M1004 291 L 916 291" stroke="#3b88bf" stroke-width="2.6" fill="none" marker-end="url(#hv-arrow-blue)"/>

    <text x="1035" y="140" fill="#24628f" font-size="16" font-weight="600">FOR ADMINISTRATORS</text>
    <line x1="1215" y1="134" x2="1555" y2="134" stroke="#b7d5ea" stroke-width="1.6"/>

    <rect x="1035" y="152" width="250" height="66" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#3b88bf" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <rect x="1035" y="152" width="7" height="66" rx="3" fill="#3b88bf"/>
    <text x="1055" y="180" fill="#24628f" font-size="16" font-weight="600" font-family="'Fira Code', monospace">hubAdmin</text>
    <text x="1055" y="202" fill="#5b5b5b" font-size="12.5">build &amp; validate configs</text>

    <rect x="1305" y="152" width="250" height="66" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#3b88bf" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <rect x="1305" y="152" width="7" height="66" rx="3" fill="#3b88bf"/>
    <text x="1325" y="180" fill="#24628f" font-size="16" font-weight="600" font-family="'Fira Code', monospace">schemas · hubDocs</text>
    <text x="1325" y="202" fill="#5b5b5b" font-size="12.5">the spec, and how to use it</text>

    <rect x="1035" y="228" width="250" height="66" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#3b88bf" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <rect x="1035" y="228" width="7" height="66" rx="3" fill="#3b88bf"/>
    <text x="1055" y="256" fill="#24628f" font-size="16" font-weight="600" font-family="'Fira Code', monospace">hubCI</text>
    <text x="1055" y="278" fill="#5b5b5b" font-size="12.5">install GitHub Actions</text>

    <rect x="1305" y="228" width="250" height="66" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#3b88bf" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <rect x="1305" y="228" width="7" height="66" rx="3" fill="#3b88bf"/>
    <text x="1325" y="256" fill="#24628f" font-size="16" font-weight="600" font-family="'Fira Code', monospace">hubValidations</text>
    <text x="1325" y="278" fill="#5b5b5b" font-size="12.5">customise validation</text>
  </g>

  <!-- ============================== 2. MODELERS ============================= -->
  <g class="fragment" data-fragment-index="2">
    <!-- model-output/: one band per submitting team -->
    <rect x="560" y="222" width="175" height="190" rx="12" fill="#fdf9f1" stroke="#d1861b" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <text x="647" y="250" text-anchor="middle" fill="#a8670f" font-size="14" font-weight="600" font-family="'Fira Code', monospace">model-output/</text>
    <rect x="578" y="264" width="139" height="24" rx="5" fill="#f8e3ae" stroke="#d1861b" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <rect x="578" y="293" width="139" height="24" rx="5" fill="#f2cd85" stroke="#d1861b" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <rect x="578" y="322" width="139" height="24" rx="5" fill="#ebb65e" stroke="#d1861b" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <rect x="578" y="351" width="139" height="24" rx="5" fill="#e39f38" stroke="#d1861b" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <text x="647" y="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#5b5b5b" font-size="12.5">one folder per model</text>

    <rect x="20" y="180" width="190" height="76" rx="14" fill="#fdf3e2" stroke="#d1861b" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <use href="#hv-person" x="40" y="200" width="34" height="34" fill="#d1861b"/>
    <text x="88" y="216" fill="#a8670f" font-size="19" font-weight="600">Modeler</text>
    <text x="88" y="238" fill="#5b5b5b" font-size="12.5">mechanistic</text>

    <rect x="20" y="268" width="190" height="76" rx="14" fill="#fdf3e2" stroke="#d1861b" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <use href="#hv-person" x="40" y="288" width="34" height="34" fill="#d1861b"/>
    <text x="88" y="304" fill="#a8670f" font-size="19" font-weight="600">Modeler</text>
    <text x="88" y="326" fill="#5b5b5b" font-size="12.5">statistical</text>

    <rect x="20" y="356" width="190" height="76" rx="14" fill="#fdf3e2" stroke="#d1861b" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <use href="#hv-person" x="40" y="376" width="34" height="34" fill="#d1861b"/>
    <text x="88" y="392" fill="#a8670f" font-size="19" font-weight="600">Modeler</text>
    <text x="88" y="414" fill="#5b5b5b" font-size="12.5">machine learning</text>

    <path d="M214 218 C 290 218, 300 255, 364 255" fill="none" stroke="#d1861b" stroke-width="2.6" marker-end="url(#hv-arrow-amber)"/>
    <path d="M214 306 C 290 306, 300 291, 364 291" fill="none" stroke="#d1861b" stroke-width="2.6" marker-end="url(#hv-arrow-amber)"/>
    <path d="M214 394 C 290 394, 300 327, 364 327" fill="none" stroke="#d1861b" stroke-width="2.6" marker-end="url(#hv-arrow-amber)"/>

    <text x="288" y="140" text-anchor="middle" fill="#a8670f" font-size="16" font-weight="600">model output</text>
    <text x="288" y="162" text-anchor="middle" fill="#5b5b5b" font-size="13">in the hub standard</text>

    <text x="1035" y="340" fill="#a8670f" font-size="16" font-weight="600">FOR MODELERS</text>
    <line x1="1178" y1="334" x2="1555" y2="334" stroke="#eccfa4" stroke-width="1.6"/>

    <rect x="1035" y="352" width="250" height="66" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#d1861b" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <rect x="1035" y="352" width="7" height="66" rx="3" fill="#d1861b"/>
    <text x="1055" y="380" fill="#a8670f" font-size="16" font-weight="600" font-family="'Fira Code', monospace">hubValidations</text>
    <text x="1055" y="402" fill="#5b5b5b" font-size="12.5">check before you submit</text>

    <rect x="1305" y="352" width="250" height="66" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#d1861b" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <rect x="1305" y="352" width="7" height="66" rx="3" fill="#d1861b"/>
    <text x="1325" y="380" fill="#a8670f" font-size="16" font-weight="600" font-family="'Fira Code', monospace">hubData</text>
    <text x="1325" y="402" fill="#5b5b5b" font-size="12.5">read the whole hub (R / Py)</text>
  </g>

  <!-- =============================== 3. ANALYST ============================= -->
  <g class="fragment" data-fragment-index="3">
    <path d="M640 434 L640 512" stroke="#7d5ba6" stroke-width="2.6" fill="none" marker-end="url(#hv-arrow-purple)"/>
    <text x="668" y="452" fill="#7d5ba6" font-size="15" font-weight="600">secondary analyses</text>
    <text x="668" y="474" fill="#5b5b5b" font-size="13.5">ensembles · visualisations · evaluations</text>

    <rect x="490" y="516" width="300" height="80" rx="14" fill="#f2edf8" stroke="#7d5ba6" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <use href="#hv-person" x="512" y="538" width="34" height="34" fill="#7d5ba6"/>
    <text x="560" y="554" fill="#5f3f88" font-size="19" font-weight="600">Analyst</text>
    <text x="560" y="576" fill="#5b5b5b" font-size="12.5">works across all the models at once</text>

    <text x="1035" y="464" fill="#5f3f88" font-size="16" font-weight="600">FOR ANALYSTS</text>
    <line x1="1168" y1="458" x2="1555" y2="458" stroke="#cbb6e6" stroke-width="1.6"/>

    <rect x="1035" y="476" width="250" height="66" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#7d5ba6" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <rect x="1035" y="476" width="7" height="66" rx="3" fill="#7d5ba6"/>
    <text x="1055" y="504" fill="#5f3f88" font-size="16" font-weight="600" font-family="'Fira Code', monospace">hubData</text>
    <text x="1055" y="526" fill="#5b5b5b" font-size="12.5">query without cloning</text>

    <rect x="1305" y="476" width="250" height="66" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#7d5ba6" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <rect x="1305" y="476" width="7" height="66" rx="3" fill="#7d5ba6"/>
    <text x="1325" y="504" fill="#5f3f88" font-size="16" font-weight="600" font-family="'Fira Code', monospace">hubVis</text>
    <text x="1325" y="526" fill="#5b5b5b" font-size="12.5">plot model output</text>

    <rect x="1035" y="552" width="250" height="66" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#7d5ba6" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <rect x="1035" y="552" width="7" height="66" rx="3" fill="#7d5ba6"/>
    <text x="1055" y="580" fill="#5f3f88" font-size="16" font-weight="600" font-family="'Fira Code', monospace">hubEnsembles</text>
    <text x="1055" y="602" fill="#5b5b5b" font-size="12.5">combine models</text>

    <rect x="1305" y="552" width="250" height="66" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#7d5ba6" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <rect x="1305" y="552" width="7" height="66" rx="3" fill="#7d5ba6"/>
    <text x="1325" y="580" fill="#5f3f88" font-size="16" font-weight="600" font-family="'Fira Code', monospace">hubEvals</text>
    <text x="1325" y="602" fill="#5b5b5b" font-size="12.5">score against target data</text>
  </g>

  <!-- ============================ 4. STAKEHOLDERS =========================== -->
  <g class="fragment" data-fragment-index="4">
    <path d="M640 598 L640 706" stroke="#2f9e8f" stroke-width="2.6" fill="none" marker-end="url(#hv-arrow-teal)"/>
    <text x="668" y="634" fill="#1f7568" font-size="15" font-weight="600">hub output</text>
    <text x="668" y="656" fill="#5b5b5b" font-size="13.5">dashboards · reports · briefings</text>

    <rect x="460" y="710" width="360" height="92" rx="14" fill="#e8f6f4" stroke="#2f9e8f" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <use href="#hv-person" x="484" y="732" width="32" height="32" fill="#2f9e8f"/>
    <use href="#hv-person" x="516" y="732" width="32" height="32" fill="#2f9e8f"/>
    <use href="#hv-person" x="548" y="732" width="32" height="32" fill="#2f9e8f"/>
    <text x="596" y="754" fill="#1f7568" font-size="19" font-weight="600">Stakeholders</text>
    <text x="596" y="778" fill="#5b5b5b" font-size="12.5">public health decision-makers</text>

    <text x="1035" y="664" fill="#1f7568" font-size="16" font-weight="600">FOR STAKEHOLDERS</text>
    <line x1="1213" y1="658" x2="1555" y2="658" stroke="#a9ddd5" stroke-width="1.6"/>

    <rect x="1035" y="676" width="250" height="66" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#2f9e8f" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <rect x="1035" y="676" width="7" height="66" rx="3" fill="#2f9e8f"/>
    <text x="1055" y="704" fill="#1f7568" font-size="14.5" font-weight="600" font-family="'Fira Code', monospace">dashboard template</text>
    <text x="1055" y="726" fill="#5b5b5b" font-size="12.5">static, no backend</text>

    <rect x="1305" y="676" width="250" height="66" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#2f9e8f" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <rect x="1305" y="676" width="7" height="66" rx="3" fill="#2f9e8f"/>
    <text x="1325" y="704" fill="#1f7568" font-size="14.5" font-weight="600" font-family="'Fira Code', monospace">cloud mirror</text>
    <text x="1325" y="726" fill="#5b5b5b" font-size="12.5">public S3, open data</text>
  </g>

  <!-- ============================= 5. DEVELOPERS ============================ -->
  <g class="fragment" data-fragment-index="5">
    <line x1="1035" y1="790" x2="1555" y2="790" stroke="#cfd8de" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <rect x="1035" y="808" width="520" height="76" rx="12" fill="#f0f0f0" stroke="#8a8a8a" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <use href="#hv-person" x="1058" y="828" width="34" height="34" fill="#5b5b5b"/>
    <text x="1106" y="843" fill="#3f3f3f" font-size="18" font-weight="600">Hubverse developers &amp; community</text>
    <text x="1106" y="866" fill="#5b5b5b" font-size="13">build the tools · docs · schemas · outreach, openly and in the open</text>
  </g>
</svg>
```
